title: Easier ominous key
description: this mod makes getting an ominous key easy
body:
This mod makes getting a ominous key **very** **VERY** i mean **_VERY_** eazy.

just go to a trail chamber, go to the breeze rod, kill a breeze, get a breeze rod, click on **_O_** and there is you ominous key. its that easy.
